import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=['Basic', '2n Cycle', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD'])
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = df[spending_cols].mean()
spending_means.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(spending_cols)))
ax2.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# 3. Purchase channels distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_data.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax3, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                   colors=sns.color_palette("husl", len(purchase_cols)))
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('')

# 4. Age distribution (calculated from Year_Birth)
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']  # Assuming current year is 2024
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# 5. Correlation heatmap of spending categories
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
correlation_matrix = df[spending_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax5, cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation'})
ax5.set_title('Correlation Between Spending Categories', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Income vs Total Spending
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', alpha=0.6, ax=ax6, 
                hue='Education', size='Total_Spending', sizes=(20, 200))
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 7. Family composition analysis
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()
family_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(family_counts)))
ax7.set_title('Distribution of Number of Children per Household', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=12)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# 8. Campaign response analysis
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_responses = df[campaign_cols].sum()
campaign_responses.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax8, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(campaign_cols)))
ax8.set_title('Campaign Response Rates', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=12)
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# 9. Recency distribution
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Recency', bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax9)
ax9.set_title('Days Since Last Purchase Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase', fontsize=12)
ax9.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
